nodes.dezerterzy.text.t: "Two deserters and a spy? On our street that's called by its trade name: to whom, for how much, for how long. I'm not saying it went badly for you. Just next time think about who wears a uniform and who only borrowed one."

nodes.klucz_oddany.text.t: "The key? Oh, that one." Nipper pretends he never looked for it. "The sewer rat handed it in, did he? Means somebody feels foolish and somebody doesn't. It fits two locks I won't name."

nodes.klucz_zatrzymany.text.t: "The key? I heard you've got it. I'm not saying anything, but when a street kid loses something once, he guards it better the second time, and you remember that." He shrugs as if he couldn't care less and looks aside.

nodes.miasto.text.t: "Right, listen. Glassmakers' Alley round the corner, you'll buy herbs there and glass for anything that gets brewed. The House of Silence, because they take in those who've seen too much. The Port, if you want to ship something you're not allowed to carry. The Barracks, if you want to send somebody away empty-handed. The Common Graveyard, if it's all the same to you by now." He points in four directions like he's shooing flies.

nodes.otwiera.options.[dalej].text.t: Thanks. See you on the other side.

nodes.otwiera.text.t: Nipper looks right, left, and then up, in case of watchers on the roofs. "Right. You've got the paper, you've got the story, and you've got the face of someone who knows he shouldn't. There's the palace kitchen, and a cook who owes me a favour. In by the servants' stairs, at night. Nobody will stop you, because nobody will be looking."

nodes.powrot.options.[dezerterzy].text.t: Heard about the two deserters from the front?

nodes.powrot.options.[klucz_zatrzymany]..t: About that key from the sewer…

nodes.powrot.options.[otwiera].text.t: I've got proof. Get me into the palace.

nodes.powrot.options.[zold].text.t: Somebody supposedly brought the pay and didn't hand over all of it.

nodes.powrot.text.t: Nipper pops up next to you as if he'd been standing around the corner all along, waiting for you to look. "Oh, you again, sir. The street changes faster than prices. What is it this time?"

nodes.przejscia.text.t: "Passages? Since we're such good friends. There's the Old Waterworks, three days' trail from the walls. Half the street hides there when the army raids. And inside you can see things the Emperor would rather bury deeper." He winks. "I never said anything."

nodes.ulica.options.[dezerterzy].text.t: Heard about the two deserters from the front?

nodes.ulica.options.[klucz_zatrzymany].t.t: About that key from the sewer…

nodes.ulica.options.[otwiera].text.t: I've got proof. Get me into the palace.

nodes.ulica.options.[zold].text.t: Somebody supposedly brought the pay and didn't hand over all of it.

nodes.ulica.text.t: Nipper leans against the wall and adjusts his green cap. He looks at your hands, then behind your back, out of habit. "Well. What's it about?"

nodes.zold.text.t: "Pay? I heard. On the street nobody would feel guilty, here conscience is cheaper than bread. They say the sergeant at the fort still curses someone in a grey cloak to this day. Wonder who."
